SELECT cl.claim_id, c.ml_user_id, c.access_token, c.status, c.bridge_enabled,
       (SELECT a.custom_attributes->>'receive_only' FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = c.account_id) AS receive_only
FROM meli_claims cl
JOIN meli_credentials c ON c.account_id = cl.account_id
WHERE cl.account_id = {{ $json.account_id }} AND cl.claim_id = '{{ $json.claim_id }}'
LIMIT 1;
